answer: Admission to the ivory requires attestations from five of the twelve clusters the ivory computes from its trust graph each epoch, and a cluster's m-th attestation that epoch burns m jade from its members. The ivory records which clusters vouched for each fable, so fables sharing one attesting set collide there and are voided. An honest fable costs about 5 jade, while 1,000 fables from a ring owning five clusters burn roughly 2.5 million jade. It breaks if fakes can be cheaply embedded across many clusters.
